mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(t1.cnt, 0) AS todayOrders, COALESCE(t1.amt, 0) AS todaySales, COALESCE(t2.cnt, 0) AS pendingDelivery, COALESCE(t3.cnt, 0) AS pendingAfterSale FROM (SELECT 1) dummy LEFT JOIN (SELECT COUNT(*) cnt, COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0) amt FROM share_order.order_info WHERE supplier_id = #{merchantId} AND DATE(create_time) = CURDATE() AND status = '1') t1 ON 1=1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT COUNT(*) cnt FROM share_order.order_info WHERE supplier_id = #{merchantId} AND status = '1') t2 ON 1=1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT COUNT(*) cnt FROM share_order.after_sale_request WHERE merchant_id = #{merchantId} AND audit_status = '0') t3 ON 1=1
